create_feature_extractor: create a VibeVoiceAcousticTokenizerFeatureExtractor with custom sampling rate and normalization settings
run_audio_normalization: run RMS normalization on mono audio tensors to target dBFS with automatic clipping
pad_audio_sequences: pad a batch of mono audio tensors to the same length with padding mask generation
process_mono_audio_tensors: process a list of mono audio tensors into normalized, padded BatchFeature with input_values and padding_mask
validate_audio_sampling_rate: validate that the provided audio sampling rate matches the feature extractor's expected sampling rate
